label: late original-phase steps (t=5-7) after several r/3/l/o inputs
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, at late positions: never at t<=2, never on <DEL> or in the copy phase. 91% of mass is at t=5-7 (peak t=6, rate about 10% at orig_idx 6-7), so it is more common for long sequences (L=8-9). Within that window, firing depends on which tokens came earlier: it is enriched when r, 3, l, o (also z, f, x, h) appeared one or two steps back or earlier, and when the current token is a first occurrence (input 1 is the most enriched current token). Requiring 2 or more earlier r/3/l/o inputs raises precision from 8% to 26% and keeps 62% of mass. Higher counts of these tokens raise precision (40% at 3 or more) but cut recall. It looks like a graded, history-weighted sum with no clean token rule, so the position window is solid but the token condition is only approximate.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig3=3 (+2.32), orig3=r (+2.30), orig2=r (+2.06), orig1=o (+1.98), orig3=l (+1.97), orig2=3 (+1.94). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-9.21), prev3_tok=- (-8.44), in_tok=o (-4.74), in_tok=e (-3.75).
